Who We Are

MIC-JASIRI
PRODUCTIONS

Mic-Jasiri Productions is a registered limited liability production company based in Nairobi, Kenya, founded in 2024. We provide a full spectrum of services — from audiovisual strategy and concept development to editing, graphic design, and live stream production.

We are dedicated to delivering top-tier content that combines precision and creativity. Whether it is video production, TV commercials, event live streaming, or conference coverage, we bring your vision to life with bespoke strategies designed to engage audiences and elevate your brand.

We thrive on innovation, collaboration, and adaptability — ensuring every project is results-driven and aligned with your success.

Meet the Founder

ALI SISEI

Ali Sisei is the CEO and Founder of Mic-Jasiri Productions, bringing over 9 years of hands-on experience in film, television, and commercial production. While Mic-Jasiri is a young company, it is built on a foundation of proven expertise and a track record that speaks for itself.

Ali has personally worked on more than 50 productions — spanning short films, reality TV, series, and corporate content. He is known for leading complex productions from concept to final delivery with precision and passion.

When Ali founded Mic-Jasiri, he didn't start from scratch — he brought nearly a decade of real-world production knowledge, a trusted network, and a deep commitment to quality that clients can count on.

Our Work

OUR PORTFOLIO

Three brands. Three stories. Every frame crafted with intention — clean, visual, and built to last.

01
Events & Concerts

BIZBAZAAR
FESTIVAL

BizBuzz is a premier event company known for its vibrant, international gatherings. Their flagship event, BizBazaar, is a dynamic exhibition that brings together global vendors, live performances, and immersive experiences.

As the official comms partner, Mic-Jasiri captured the energy of these two-day gatherings held four times a year — from highlight reels to vivid photography, showcasing vendors, artists, live performances, and a dedicated kids' zone.

Highlight Reels Photography Live Coverage
Official Comms Partner
Conference & Livestreaming

50 WOMEN
ON BOARD

50:50 Women on Board is a global movement dedicated to empowering women as leaders and ensuring they have a voice at the highest levels of governance.

As the official visual partner for their international conference held in Nairobi, Kenya, Mic-Jasiri delivered end-to-end high-quality video production and photography. Every powerful moment — from keynote speeches to audience engagement — was captured with precision, ensuring this landmark event for women's leadership was shared globally.

Video Production Photography Livestreaming
Official Visual Partner
02
03
Digital Commercial Advertisements & Strategy

MANAMA
SPA

Manama Spa is a premium, high-end spa located in Karen, Nairobi. Mic-Jasiri had the privilege of crafting their digital TV commercial and photography — capturing the essence of elegance and sophistication that defines their brand.

Beyond the visuals, a tailored digital strategy was developed — leveraging the luxury TV commercial and photography to guide a digital roadmap using targeted reels and strategic posts to reach Manama's affluent clientele in this competitive market.

TV Commercial Photography Digital Strategy
